title: Match dedupe identity excludes date, keyed on season+competition+teams+score
evidence: src/soccer_loader.erl:174-184 — K omits date; two genuinely distinct meetings of the same teams in the same season/competition with an identical scoreline (e.g. a cup tie and its replay) would be collapsed to one.
suggestion: Acceptable given overlapping-file dates are a day off, but noting the trade-off; could include a coarse date bucket in the key.

title: BR-Football-Dataset season derived from date (year), not a season column
evidence: src/soccer_loader.erl:104-107 — season defaults to D div 10000 when no season field; calendar-year seasons are fine but cross-year competitions could misattribute edge matches.
suggestion: Documented in a code comment; no action needed for the provided data.

title: club_summary silently drops players with blank club name
evidence: src/soccer_tools.erl:174 — list comprehension guard `Club =/= <<>>` filters empty clubs from the output.
suggestion: Reasonable; free agents have no club to aggregate under.
